title: Robo's Cubical Celestial Bodies
body:
![A Minecraft sunset using this resource pack.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/97163583a47b255ba2c996c5889175e3ac57d41c_0.webp)

## A small resource pack that turns Minecraft's Sun and Moon into 3D cubes!

That's pretty much all there is to it.

![All of the different moon phases.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/62ef6ebeb50b5b06b4093e06e1e21f8b6aaff8a5_0.webp)

_Inspired by "[Cubic Sun & Moon](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/cubic-sun-moon)" by JoeFly, but I adjusted the perspective to make it appear as though the Sun and Moon are farther away. All assets in this resource pack were made by me in Blender._
